summary: This is a Mol Labs public hypothesis card (P13) proposing a pre-registered assay to test whether BAK (Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer) loss-of-function abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell killing at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax killing on matched senescent cultures. The document is a research-stage proposal (TRL 1–2) with no experimental data yet generated; all key variables are either drawn from literature or marked UNKNOWN/PREDICTION. The card identifies critical gaps in the existing P5–P12 series and outlines the specific epistasis experiment needed to resolve BAK's role in FOXO4-DRI-mediated senolysis.

content_blocks.title: Central Claim (Pre-registered Hypothesis)
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture, BAK (Bak1) loss-of-function (or BAK block) abolishes FOXO4-DRI senescent-cell kill at least as completely as it abolishes navitoclax kill. Pre-registered criterion: relative kill loss_FOXO4 ≥ relative kill loss_navitoclax, with each arm showing ≥20% relative kill loss vs the same senolytic on control genotype/vehicle. This is a PREDICTION — no experimental data exist yet.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale and Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: BAK is a sister multi-domain effector pore to BAX. FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax acts via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w inhibition. Both may require BAK as a multi-domain effector pore into MOMP, or FOXO4-DRI may remain partially BAK-independent (via Bax compensation) while navitoclax is abolished — or the reverse. This card is part of a series (P5–P12) covering Bax, apoptosome/caspase-9, caspase-8, caspase-3, and BID; P7/P8 Bax ≠ BAK isoform complement. Soft-claims: FOXO4-DRI∩BAK LOF/epistasis/navitoclax H2H soft-complete = 0; matched BAK H2H remains UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 28340339 (Baar 2017, Cell): FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 → senescent-cell apoptosis; no BAK LOF arm. DOI: 10.1016/j.cell.2017.02.031.
2. PMID 41625068 (2025, Front. Bioeng.): Endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade; ≠ BAK LOF vs navitoclax H2H. DOI: 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1729166.
3. PMID 26711051 (Zhu 2016, Aging Cell): Navitoclax senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted. DOI: 10.1111/acel.12445.
4. PMID 11326099 (Wei 2001, Science): BAX and BAK are a requisite gateway to mitochondrial dysfunction and death (classical MOMP prior); not a FOXO4-DRI SC matched panel. DOI: 10.1126/science.1059108.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured vs. Predicted
content_blocks.content:
Baseline claimed: BAK LOF or block abolishes FOXO4-DRI SC kill ≥ navitoclax on matched SC cultures.
Baseline measured:
- FOXO4–p53 entry: LITERATURE (PMID 28340339)
- Downstream BCL-2/caspase-3 framing: LITERATURE without BAK LOF H2H (PMID 41625068)
- Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic: LITERATURE (PMID 26711051)
- Wei BAX/BAK gateway: LITERATURE as classical MOMP prior (PMID 11326099)
- Matched BAK LOF × FOXO4-DRI vs navitoclax % kill abolish: UNKNOWN
- ≥ equal abolish (loss_FOXO4 ≥ loss_nav; each ≥20% relative): PREDICTION
- P5–P12 do not prove this epistasis — P7/P8 Bax ≠ BAK.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P5–P12 as proving P13 — Bax/residual/apoptosome/caspase-8/caspase-3/BID cards did not run BAK-alone LOF; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated ≥ equal abolish; P7/P8 Bax ≠ BAK.
2. Caspase-3 cascade ≠ BAK necessity — PMID 41625068 implicates p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 without genetic BAK requirement or navitoclax-matched abolish.
3. Wei ≠ FOXO4-DRI panel — classical BAX/BAK gateway prior is not a senolytic H2H; ≥ equal abolish is stronger than shared multi-domain effector language; Bax may compensate under BAK-alone LOF; navitoclax-insensitive SC types confound matched culture choice.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria and Proposed Method
content_blocks.content:
Refute if: On the pre-registered matched panel, FOXO4-DRI kill largely survives BAK LOF/BAK block while navitoclax kill is abolished, or relative kill loss_FOXO4 is below relative kill loss_navitoclax outside the pre-registered ≥ equal band — indicating pathway-sparing/BAK-independent (including Bax-compensated) FOXO4-DRI execution.
Method: propose-assay. Execution status: NOT_RUN.
Ask a human: Lock one senescent system sensitive to both senolytics, BAK LOF vs BAK block tool, and viability + MOMP/caspase readout before claiming ≥ equal abolish; do not treat P5–P12 as proof; P7/P8 Bax ≠ BAK; no dosing.
